OA-Target: Identify the requested quantity, scope, period, units, formula and output precision from the question. Use supplied pages first. Missing evidence remains missing; never invent a value or use an expected answer to choose a formula.
OA-Locate: Search a specific missing fact in candidate files. A grep hit is a location: read its body; rereading hits is not reading the table. scoped_search batches search and reading. read_context before+after <=12000 Unicode characters. Change the source/issue for a missing period; avoid overlapping rereads.
OA-Table: For a complete numeric calculation with unambiguous rows, prefer table_calculate. It reads real source_ref text, extracts cells, computes and submits without a model rewrite. tables: key, source_ref, ordered rows, exact column, quoted unit, optional header_hint/offset/length. bindings maps operand fields to ordered table keys, e.g. numerator:[a],denominator:[b], or values:[series]. calculation selects method, operation, decimals and named options. submit_answer=true declares the full task calculation. needs_input requires correcting the reported evidence gap. Missing year labels, shifted cells and duplicate rows require a clearer source, never guessed mapping. Use intermediate Programs when this is only a partial calculation.
OA-Units: Bind the full header and unit: total/component, nominal/real, fiscal/calendar, thousands/millions and currency direction. Preserve signs, decimals and footnotes; blank/dash is not zero. No implicit unit conversion in table_calculate. treasury_transform handles explicit scale, currency and quote conventions.
OA-Stats: Choose the defined denominator. Difference=new-old; relative change=(new-base)/base; symmetric difference=abs(new-old)/((abs(old)+abs(new))/2); share difference=part2/total2-part1/total1. Percent/percentage points multiply by 100. Annual log growth=ln(new/base)/elapsed_intervals; CAGR=exp(ln(new/base)/elapsed_intervals)-1. Population variance uses n, sample n-1. Use named series_metrics operations; table_calculate also supports absolute_relative_change. Never mix totals/components or round before the last step. Execute long-series calculations before finish-only.
OA-Commit: Submit the supported requested result immediately. Successful table_calculate uses the existing final-answer path; there is no extra LLM rewrite. Otherwise finish with the computed answer unchanged, under the shared output contract. No compulsory verification call.
OA-Fallback: All seven Programs remain callable. Prefer source-bound table_calculate for full-task arithmetic. Otherwise use an intermediate Program or temporary top-level Python with existing ctx, no inputs/run wrapper/ctx reassignment. ctx.call shares the budget. Check accepted and documented paths; return compact JSON. No repeated invalid calls.
OA-Periods: Enumerate requested periods and fiscal/calendar basis; inclusive observations differ from elapsed intervals. No omitted periods, duplicate vintages or interpolation. Forecast error needs an independently published target actual. An issue may lag observations: retrieve that actual from a later issue instead of substituting the last fitting value.
OA-Fiscal: Keep fiscal and calendar totals separate. A fiscal year is not automatically January through December; follow the source period definition and any transition quarter. Compare flows over matching intervals and stocks at matching dates.
OA-Treasury: Distinguish debt outstanding, issuance/redemption flows, holdings and net changes; retain marketable/nonmarketable and investor categories. Treasury price ticks, fine/troy weights and exchange-rate direction need explicit source conventions. Do not infer the target from a nearby similar total.
OA-Advanced: Polynomial OLS: table_calculate bindings observations:[series], actual:[target]; calculation method=polynomial_forecast, operation=predict|absolute_error, degree, first_x, x_step, prediction_x, decimals. It uses an intercept and exact coverage checks; labels and source unit must be consistent. For other models preserve specified order, intercept and horizon. NumPy is available; scipy/statsmodels are not installed. Never silently substitute a different model.
OA-Revision: Respect requested publication vintage and as-of date. Later revisions may differ from originally reported values; select the specified vintage, not the value that seems most plausible. Preserve preliminary/adjusted status and footnotes.
